newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares ease on foreign investment doubts.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares ease on foreign investment doubts.

text.p: Slovenian shares eased 0.58 percent on Tuesday due to market talk foreign investment may be restricted.
"Some traders are afraid the Bank of Slovenia may limit the amount foreigners can invest in Slovenia -- but that is very unlikely," a broker said.
* The 10-share SBI index fell 6.73 points to 1,152.7.
* Issue A of drug company Lek had the highest turnover, falling 2.23 percent to 18,450 tolars on volume of 3,065 shares. --Marja Novak, Ljubljana Newsroom, 386 61 1263 644
